== Acquisition ==
Part of [[Gwen (disguise)|Gwen's]] replacement [[skill bar]] during [[The Flight North]] mission.

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Feign Death}}

== Notes ==
* This skill will normally be inactive. You need to stand in the shadows next to a wall for it to become available.
* Since it does not have a recharge [[duration]], you can simply blow your cover and reapply this skill in the same place to extend its duration.
